description: I am Aryan Srivastava, currently pursuing a Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science from SRM University, Chennai, with a CGPA of 9.45. I am a driven and results-oriented Data Scientist and Software Engineer with hands-on experience in machine learning, data analysis, and web development.

I am studying at SRM University and maintaining a CGPA of 9.45. I completed my 12th from ST Xavier's School, Jaunpur, with 93.8%, and my 10th from Rani Laxmi Bai Memorial School, Lucknow, with 92.83%.

As a Web Development Intern at Nexus Info, I developed a responsive login/registration page using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. I also engineered a full-stack restaurant website with user authentication and interactive UI elements, ensuring cross-device compatibility and collaborating in a team-based environment to deliver the project on time.

At Fessopro, I designed and developed a movie ticket booking system using C++ and MySQL. The project included real-time seat reservations, a command-line interface, and integrated SQL queries for efficient data management.

Detectify is an AI-powered security system that I built using TensorFlow.js, Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS. It automatically detects humans in real time, triggers alerts, and features color-coded object detection with video feed processing every 10ms.

In the Health-Horizon project, I created a disease prediction model using NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, and Tkinter. The system achieved 94% accuracy and included a user-friendly interface for real-time interaction with healthcare professionals.

I built a UPI Fraud Detection model using Python, Pandas, and Seaborn. The model addressed data imbalance using oversampling techniques, achieving high recall for detecting fraudulent transactions and providing actionable insights.

In the iPhone Sales Analysis project, I analyzed sales data using Python, Plotly, and Matplotlib. The project identified key trends in pricing, discounts, and customer ratings, enabling data-driven decisions for optimizing sales strategies.

I am proficient in programming languages like C++, Python, and JavaScript, and web technologies such as HTML, CSS, React.js, and Next.js. I have expertise in machine learning libraries like Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, Pandas, and NumPy.
I secured 4th place out of 64 teams in the IEEE Hackathon and ranked among the top 5 students at SRM University.
I hold the Oracle Certified Foundations Associate certification, which has strengthened my knowledge of database management and programming.

As a Committee Member for Aaruush, SRM University’s annual tech fest, I managed the Drag Race event with a team of 20 volunteers and coordinated logistics for the drone competition, ensuring smooth execution.
I possess strong skills in collaboration, problem-solving, analytical thinking, and time management, which I have demonstrated during internships and volunteering activities.
I aspire to leverage my technical skills and experience to secure roles in software development or data science, contributing innovative solutions and actionable insights.

While developing the Health-Horizon application, ensuring high prediction accuracy and creating an intuitive interface were challenges I overcame through experimentation with algorithms and user-centered design.
My GitHub profile showcases projects like Detectify, Health-Horizon, and Customer Service Call Escalation Prediction, which highlight my expertise in AI, machine learning, and web development.

I am passionate about building innovative solutions using data science, machine learning, and web technologies. I strive to combine technical knowledge with creative problem-solving to address real-world challenges.

I enjoy playing cricket, working on personal coding projects, and exploring new technologies in AI and machine learning. I also like reading about stock market fundamentals and analyzing companies for investment opportunities.

I am interested in technology-driven innovations, particularly in the fields of artificial intelligence and web development. I also enjoy participating in hackathons and technical fests to test my skills and learn from others.
As a leader, I have managed teams during technical events like Aaruush. I focus on effective communication, task delegation, and ensuring smooth execution of activities.
I maintain work-life balance by managing my time effectively and setting clear priorities. My schedule includes academic studies, project work, and leisure activities like sports or reading.
I am inspired by innovators in technology like Elon Musk and Sundar Pichai, whose work exemplifies the impact of technology on global challenges.
